detail.title: Integrating Autonomous Multi-Agent Frameworks and Curiosity-Driven Exploration for Open-Ended Discovery
detail.summary: Autonomous open-ended discovery leverages intrinsic curiosity for bootstrapping exploration. Multi-agent evolutionary frameworks like CORAL significantly enhance discovery by replacing rigid control with collaborative, persistent-memory agents, overcoming exploration limits in complex landscapes.
